title: Book of the Qi-Lined Board
summary: Teaches students who already guard with a shield to line the whole board with qi against heavy cuts.

title: Second Course in Boss and Rim
summary: Extends the boss and rim strikes of the primers with qi and footwork for students ready for harder opponents.

title: The Turning Shield Treatise
summary: A treatise on turning blows aside with the angled board and sending qi along the arm to control the turn.

title: Intermediate Drills for the Shield Line
summary: Drills shield bearers to stand shoulder to shoulder in a line and advance and hold together with qi.

title: A Guide to Counter-Bashing
summary: A short guide to answering an opponent's strike with an immediate bash and qi in the shoulder.

title: Manual of the Heavy Tower Facing
summary: Teaches how to plant and move behind a body-length tower shield with qi bracing legs and arm.

title: The Roundshield Compendium
summary: Gathers the quick turns and spinning guards of the small round shield for mobile fighters with some qi.

title: Discourse on Shield and Short Sword
summary: Joins shield guards to short sword thrusts in a single rhythm of cover and stab with qi in both hands.

title: The Missile-Turning Handbook
summary: Shows how to cover against arrows and bolts and thrown spears and to turn them with the board and qi.

title: Notes on the Pushing Guard
summary: Notes on holding ground while pressing an opponent steadily backward with the board and a continuous flow of qi.
